speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, when did your fever and headache start, and have you noticed any rash or stiff neck?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malaria (specifically Plasmodium vivax or falciparum). The history of consuming contaminated ice cream is a distractor; the constellation of fever, headache, and malaise in a pregnant patient requires immediate evaluation for parasitic infection. I will now request a blood smear and rapid diagnostic test. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Smear, Malaria_Antigen_Test.
